entities.name: PMID:25070944
observations: Tolstrup and Brandstrup evaluated agreement between cumulative nurse-charted fluid balance and body-weight change in 113 ASA I–III elective colorectal surgical patients over postoperative days 1–6.

entities.name: Colorectal fluid chart disagreement
observations: In 113 elective colorectal surgery patients, fluid-chart versus weight-change mean discrepancy rose to 1.2 kg/L on day 5 (p<0.002) and 2 kg/L on day 6 (p<0.0001); Bland–Altman limits were wide (>6 to nearly 10 kg/L), leading authors to advise against using fluid charts alone.
